title: The Man Who Almost Killed The Ottoman Empire
hook: You think the Ottoman Empire fell to Russia or Britain? It nearly died by knife in 1453, courtesy of a furious janissary.
description:
Discover how the Ottoman Empire survived a mutiny in 1453 to conquer Constantinople.

Subscribe for more hidden history that textbooks miss.
#ottomanempire #history #constantinople #historyfacts #shorts

beats.say: Mehmed II is about to crush Constantinople. Millions of gunpowder rounds are loaded. The momentum is absolute.
Then, a single janissary stabs the Sultan for unpaid wages. The chain of command shatters instantly.
Generals refuse to fight. The army scatters. The greatest siege of the Middle Ages collapses in hours.
Mehmed survives, barely. He realizes his empire is only as strong as his payroll. Weakness is a choice.
He pays the troops. He doubles the gold reserves. He returns with twice the force and merciless discipline.
May 29, 1453. The gates fall. Istanbul rises. The medieval world ends because a Sultan balanced his checkbook.
